targetText: It is the common lot of woman and worker to be oppressed. The forms of oppression have differed in successive ages and in various countries, but the oppression itself remained.
explanation: Drawing on Lewis H. Morgan and Friedrich Engels, Bebel examines primeval human society through savagery, barbarism, and civilization. He establishes that women and workingmen share a common history of oppression, yet primeval clan society was originally organized around maternal law (matriarchy) and communal ownership prior to the rise of private property.
